card.title: How To Recover Original Sysconfig Data from iPhone

source.title: How To Recover Original Sysconfig Data from iPhone

claims.statement: After replacing a dead NAND, activation fails until the original SysConfig (serial number, Wi-Fi MAC, Bluetooth MAC) is written to the new NAND.
Method: flash once with the new NAND, remove it, run JCID Query Code/Unbind (can take up to 30 min) to retrieve the original values, write them, refit and clean flash.
On iPhone 8–X, iRepair P10 Purple Mode 'Recover SysCfg' can pull and write the data without desoldering the NAND again.
Rule out baseband or NFC faults first, as they also cause activation failure.

procedure: Install new NAND and flash; confirm activation fails.
Remove NAND; Query Code in JCID software; note SN/Wi-Fi/BT.
Write values, refit NAND, clean flash, activate.
On 8–X optionally use iRepair P10 Purple Mode instead.
